elements.description: When an automation runs: an event or a schedule, conditions, a plain-language summary and the next run times.

properties.name: value
properties.default: { kind: "schedule", schedule: DEFAULT_SCHEDULE, active: null, conditions: [], match: "all" }
properties.description: The trigger definition. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: events
properties.description: The events a trigger can listen for

properties.name: scheduleFields
properties.description: What a schedule's conditions can test (none: schedules have no conditions)

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Names the group, shown at the top

properties.name: now
properties.description: Counts the next runs from here (ms since epoch); unset: when the element connected

properties.name: runCount
properties.description: How many next runs to list

properties.name: timeZone
properties.description: Shown under the card – unset: the browser's time zone

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the definition as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the definition out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: nextRuns
properties.description: The upcoming runs of a schedule (empty for an event trigger)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The trigger changed ({ value: TriggerValue }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

functions.name: nextTriggerRuns
functions.signature: nextTriggerRuns(schedule: TriggerSchedule, now: number, count: unknown, active?: TriggerActive | null): number[]
functions.description: The next `count` run times (ms) of a schedule after `now`, inside `active` when given

functions.name: describeTrigger
functions.signature: describeTrigger(value: TriggerValue, events: TriggerEvent[], fields?: TriggerField[]): string
functions.description: The trigger as one sentence: "Runs every Monday at 9:00 AM, only if Stage is Won."

props.name: events
props.description: The events a trigger can listen for

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The trigger definition to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole definition after every change

changelog: `tc-trigger-builder` – an event or a schedule, an active window, conditions with all/any, a plain-language summary and the next run times; form-associated (JSON under `name`, validity, reset). Built from combobox, date-range-picker and segmented-control.
